qt_add_executable(vindauga main.cpp)

# Link the QML plugin target so the static QML module (types + qml files) is
# initialised in the executable. vindauga_uiplugin is generated by qt_add_qml_module.
target_link_libraries(vindauga PRIVATE
    vindauga_ui
    vindauga_uiplugin
    vindauga_core
    Qt6::Quick Qt6::Gui
)

# Install rules for packaging. vindauga_cli is deliberately not installed: it is a
# headless development tool, not meant for end users.
install(TARGETS vindauga RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR})
install(FILES ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/packaging/vindauga.desktop
        DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/applications)

# Application icon. The source is packaging/icons/vindauga.png; the sized PNGs under
# hicolor/ are scaled from it and checked in. The window icon is embedded via qrc
# (setWindowIcon in main.cpp); the desktop environment resolves the .desktop file's
# Icon=vindauga from the hicolor theme.
set(VINDAUGA_ICON_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/packaging/icons)
qt_add_resources(vindauga "appicon"
    PREFIX "/vindauga"
    BASE ${VINDAUGA_ICON_DIR}/hicolor/256x256/apps
    FILES ${VINDAUGA_ICON_DIR}/hicolor/256x256/apps/vindauga.png
)
foreach(size 16 22 24 32 48 64 128 256 512)
    install(FILES ${VINDAUGA_ICON_DIR}/hicolor/${size}x${size}/apps/vindauga.png
            DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/icons/hicolor/${size}x${size}/apps)
endforeach()
